errors.evidence: The pie chart visually shows only three sectors (blue, red, and orange), not four. The legend lists five possible categories, but two of them have 0% and are not represented as slices in the chart.
The third sector is orange, not yellow. While similar, using the more precise color name is better, especially as it is a standard Google Charts color.
There is no purple sector visually present in the pie chart. The model is hallucinating a slice based on an entry in the legend that has a 0% value.
In the legend, the purple color is associated with the label "Изобщо не съм съгласен" (Completely disagree), not "Не съм съгласен" (Disagree), which is associated with the green color.
The value 0.1% is not written anywhere on the chart. The model is calculating the remainder from 100% and presenting it as a fact from the figure.

errors.text_span: но тъй като не е изписан, се приема, че е включван в останалите отговори
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect interpretation of why some categories are not shown. The reason they are not shown is that they have a value of 0%, not because they are included in other answers.

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени по размер, като най-големият сектор е в долната част, а останалите следват по часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The sectors are not ordered by size in a clockwise direction. Following the largest sector (47.6%) clockwise, the next sector is the smallest (19%), followed by the middle one (33.3%).
